integrity.universal_two_dimensional_proof: orthogonality, trace identity, Cayley-Hamilton recurrence, and inverse positivity

limitations: The theorem is restricted to unpreconditioned exact-line steepest descent from the zero start on real SPD Stieltjes systems with componentwise nonnegative right-hand side.
The three-dimensional witness establishes possibility and joint minimality, not frequency of sign loss in larger systems.
Older matrix-iteration literature may use different terminology for the same componentwise boundary; this remains the main originality residual risk.

title: Two dimensions protect every exact-line steepest-descent iterate; three dimensions break at step two
